featured_reviews.review_text: Yum food with best service and quality. Very polite for taking orders. Food is awesome specially cheese burger fries and maggi. We also loved Avacado toast

featured_reviews.name: Krushang Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Never make the mistake of ordering their Unlimited Burger Thali. The service is unbelievably slow — we had to wait at least 10 minutes for literally everything. Even basic items like nachos, which don’t require any cooking, took ages to be served. And after all that waiting, nothing was fresh: the food was cold, the buns were super hard and stale, and the overall quality was terrible.

In the name of “sauces,” they only serve plain mayonnaise — nothing else. I asked for the paneer burger three times and each time the paneer patty came thinner and thinner, a hilarious example of shrinkflation and cost cutting. 😂

Overall: the worst experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Sorry  for your unpleasant experience.. we try our best to make each n every customer satisfied.. we never serve plain mayo.. its not in our thali menu.. n yes.. as n when u order it takes time to prepare as everything is served fresh.. n when asked.. u told us u liked everything.. giving this review is bit surprising for us..still we request to visit us again n give a chance to serve u better

featured_reviews.name: Panda
featured_reviews.review_text: So, we came across this place after we were tired doing shopping at dmart. Me and my friend were damn hungry and ended up at this new food corner. My bestie being a hardcore nonveg lover was disappointed at 1st knowing that this place only serves veg and me being a vegetarian she was like okayyy lets give it a try and you’ll wont believe. She said that this is the best burger i ever had. Its way better than a nonveg burger. My reason to explain this whole experience is only to tell you’ll that they serve tasty burgers, i can bet on that. Dont get disappointed knowing that its a veg corner. Don’t assume anything, try on your own and you will understand what am I talking about. Apart from that the reason why i gave 4 star is only because they didn’t had milkshake the way it was described in their own booklet. The ice tea that i ordered even that wasn’t up the mark but this place still deserves a 4.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hey thankks for your feedback.. and about shake..we will def work on it..

featured_reviews.name: kanchan jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the repeated cancellation of my orders. This has now happened multiple times within just a few days. Every time, my order is accepted first, but later cancelled because a delivery partner is not available.
If delivery service is unavailable in my area, then the app should clearly show that before accepting payment and confirming the order. Accepting orders and then cancelling them later creates unnecessary inconvenience, wastes customers’ time, and gives a very poor customer experience.
Today again, the same thing happened. My order was accepted, and after waiting, it was cancelled with the same reason. This is not professional service from a brand like Burger King.
I request you to improve your delivery management system and stop accepting orders when delivery is not possible. Repeated cancellations reduce customer trust and create frustration.
I expect a proper response and a permanent solution to this issue.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear kanchan jadhav, We apologise for what you have experienced from our service. Please give us a chance to work on our service.Kindly write to us on customercare@burgerking.in

featured_reviews.name: Sanjeev Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Burger King with my daughter and Nephew in Bhayandar West. It was their first time visiting BK and it is very budget-friendly fast food chain. They liked the burger mostly because it was very simple with just Bun, Chicken Pattice, 2 thin cutted onion ring layers and mayo that's it. I liked the veggie Sticks and mango Sundae. I am not much of a fast food fan but I would like to visit here again.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Gajera
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience at Take and Treat! The ambience is peaceful and well-maintained, ideal for family dinners or casual meals.🍾🤤

Their soya chaap is hands down the best item — delicious, tender, and seasoned with authentic masala. The option to order half or full is perfect for managing portions. 🍕🍻

The quantity is generous, and you definitely get your money’s worth. Every dish tastes fresh and rich in flavour without being overly spicy. The staff is polite, and the service is quick. Prices are super affordable, which makes it a go-to spot for everyday dining. Coffee is smooth and aromatic, and the lemon tea is soothing after a spicy meal. 🫶🏻

The overall vibe is homely and comfortable.
If you love authentic North Indian-style flavours and want something light on the pocket, this place won’t disappoint. Definitely recommending it to friends!🤟🤟

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Take and Treat is a hidden gem for food lovers looking for great taste at affordable rates.
The ambience is simple yet clean, giving a cozy local restaurant vibe. The staff is attentive and ensures your food is served hot and fresh.
Their soya chaap is the star — soft, flavorful, and perfectly cooked, with both half and full portions available.
You can really taste the authenticity in their spices and preparation. The rest of the menu is also impressive, with decent variety and generous portions.
Every dish feels like it’s made with care, not rushed. The rates are pocket-friendly, making it perfect for students and working people. The coffee is creamy and comforting, while the lemon tea is refreshing after a heavy meal.
It’s rare to find such quality food at this price. Great for both dine-in and takeaway — Take and Treat truly lives up to its name!

featured_reviews.name: trusha mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: The food is good but the service needs to improve. Especially when there is lot of crowd the staff isn't able to handle. People were sitting and nobody was taking the order. Only when they shouted, someone came to take the order. They don't know how to take orders correctly. The waiter was so confused about everything and we had to repeat everything 5 times for him to understand and note the right order. They mess up sometimes like we ordered a jain dish and they made it non-jain which we found out after taking a bite. Saying they forgot. And sometimes they forget to prepare a dish totally. Once ordered something and they totally forgot the order but was added in the bill and another time we had to remind multiple times to finally get our dish was a simple nachos order. These things need to be worked on to improve customer experience. Everything is reasonably priced.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for the review, Trusha. We are glad you liked the food but sincerely apologize for the service confusion and order mix-ups. We are working on our staff training to improve your next experience.

Masala Soya Chaap - 10/10
Panner Tikka - 8.5/10
Tacos - 9/10
Maharaja Cheese Blast - 9/10
Brownie Shake - 10/10
Peach Mojito - 9/10
We loved every bit of it and this chaap has become our favourite. It has everything you need crisp, spice, freshness, moisture it was a blast of flavours. We highly recommend you to try it out. The staff is very friendly and the service is quick. You will definitely leave this place with a full stomach and happy heart just like we did! Also they’re celebrating their 6th year anniversary by commencing their buy 1 get 1 free offers from 5th to 10th April, don’t miss out on this amazing opportunity.

featured_reviews.name: Umair Lucky
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Consistent Reliable Spot for Quick Bites and Hangouts
​I’ve visited this McDonald’s multiple times, whether it’s for a quick breakfast, a late-night snack, or just a place to sit and work for an hour. Here’s a breakdown of my experience:
​The Food: 4/5
You know exactly what you’re getting with McDonald’s, and this branch delivers on that consistency.
​The Classics: The McAloo Tikki and McSpicy Chicken were fresh, with the buns being soft and toasted just right.
​The Fries: This is usually the dealbreaker. Most of the time, they are hot, crispy, and perfectly salted. However, during peak Sunday rush hours, I’ve occasionally received a batch that was a bit limp. Pro tip: always check them before you leave the counter!
​Desserts & Coffee: The McFlurry Oreo is a must-have. I also tried the McCafe Cold Coffee—it's surprisingly good for the price and much better than what you’d get at most fast-food joints.
​Service & Efficiency: 3/5
This is where there’s some room for improvement.
​Ordering: The self-service kiosks are a lifesaver. They make customizing your burger (like removing pickles or adding extra cheese) much easier.
​Wait Time: During weekdays, the service is lightning-fast. However, on weekend evenings, the place gets chaotic. I waited about 15–20 minutes for a simple meal last Saturday because the staff seemed overwhelmed by the influx of delivery orders (Zomato/Swiggy) alongside the dine-in crowd.
​Staff: Generally polite and helpful, though they are clearly under a lot of pressure during peak hours.
​Ambiance & Cleanliness: 4/5
​Vibe: It’s a lively, family-friendly atmosphere. It’s also a popular spot for students, so it can get a bit noisy, but that’s expected.
​Hygiene: The dining area is usually kept clean; staff are quick to wipe down tables once people leave. However, the washroom maintenance could be better, especially during the busy night shifts.
​Final Verdict:
Whether you're looking for a budget-friendly meal or a nostalgic snack, this McDonald’s is a solid choice. It’s not "fine dining," but it’s reliable, clean, and the food is always familiar.
​Recommendation: Try the Piri Piri Fries and the Spicy Paneer Wrap. Also, if you’re visiting on a weekend, try to go before 7:00 PM to avoid the massive queue!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely the Worst McDonald’s I’ve Ever Visited – Avoid at All Costs

This is by far the worst McDonald’s location I have ever been to — and I’ve visited many around the world. But This experience was beyond disappointing.

Filthy Environment: The floor was disgusting, with visible dirt and trash. There was no sign of cleaning or upkeep.
No Working AC: The entire place was hot, humid, and uncomfortable, making it nearly unbearable to sit and eat.
Disgusting Washroom: The restroom had no door, was wide open, and the stench could be smelled across the dining area. It was completely unhygienic.
Unprofessional Staff: The staff were incredibly rude and seemed uninterested in helping or providing any sort of customer service.
Poor Food Quality: I ordered a Happy Meal — it came without the box, without the toy, and to make things worse, the chicken nuggets were raw inside. Absolutely unacceptable.
•	Zero Cleanliness Standards: Compared to even the most basic local restaurants, this McDonald’s location falls far below standard.

This place should be inspected for health and safety violations. I’m shocked it’s allowed to operate under the McDonald’s brand. Truly a disgrace.

Respond for your reply

Your response is appreciated, but actions speak louder than words.

Thank you for replying, but this wasn’t just a minor issue — the condition of the store was completely unacceptable. I’ve already detailed serious hygiene concerns, undercooked food, broken air conditioning, and poor customer service. These are not small oversights; they reflect a major failure in standards.

I’ve visited many McDonald’s locations globally, and this was by far the worst experience I’ve had. I hope you take this feedback seriously and not just as a formality.

If you’re genuinely committed to improving, I suggest immediate action at the location rather than asking customers to send emails after such a poor experience.

Let your improvements speak for themselves next time — if there is one.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience was very bad. It was Women’s Day and I randomly tried this outlet. We ordered a pizza, but I’m not sure if the person who took the order even listened properly. He seemed like a young boy managing the shop.
It took more than 45–50 minutes for our order, while others received theirs on time. When we asked, he said the pizza was ready but got burnt, so they made a fresh one which seems big lie.

featured_reviews.name: Zeref
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was loyal Customer of “Shunya” from past 3 years but from few months food taste has been changed I see that the owner and employees changed completely maybe this is the reason why food taste has been changed.

I visited two times in 2026 and that two visit disappointed me very bad.

They completely depends on ready made sauces now for example I ate their pink and red sauce pasta both was crap. Because of the sweetness in the pasta which supposed to be spicy or normal.

I always ordered their fries and from past two visits fries was burned little bit because of that the taste become horrible without sauces.

I ate thier momos it was my second time and thier momos is very average as per the price.

So I’ll better see the good Restaurants and cafés rather than “Shunya”

featured_reviews.name: Bhushan Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved the food at Shunya – The Veg Delight. The taste was superb, quality was excellent, and each dish was full of rich flavors. You can truly feel the freshness and care in every bite. A must-visit place for delicious vegetarian food!

featured_reviews.name: Gagan Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
This restaurant is situated at very busy street in Bhayandar West near Maxus mall. I have seen this place crowded during weekends and less crowded on weekdays.

I got recommendation about this place by my friend for Pav Bhaji.

They have indoor and outdoor sitting options available. They have Dosa, Pav Bhaji and Chinese options in the Menu.

Place is little conjusted but Ambience is good. Food is very tasty and delicious. Staff is very nice and polite.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Happy to see the review and also will try serving the same way always like today.

featured_reviews.name: GOWM - Get Out With Me
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a road side outlet just behind maxus mall and serves very good and reasonably priced Chinese food, especially on a rainy evening if you are looking for a hot manchow soup this is the place that you need to be in. We tried the paneer Manchurian and manchow soup and it was a refreshing and perfect menu for a rainy evening.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thankyou, Do come Again and Again and get the taste of new food variations!!

featured_reviews.name: Ketan Chothe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shunya The Veg Delight, located near Maxus Mall in Bhayander West, is an okay spot for fast food lovers. If you’re into dishes like pav bhaji, tawa pulao, sandwiches, and similar snacks, you’ll find a decent variety here. The food taste and quality are average — nothing exceptional, but acceptable for a quick bite.

However, seating is limited, so it might not be ideal for a long dine-in experience. Also, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side considering the portion sizes they offer.

featured_reviews.name: Praveena Padelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lipsmacking food. Visited this today after seeing reviews. This place is located near Maxus Mall in Bhayander East. There was no crowd at all. Seating arrangements is on ground as well as on first floor. I must say I was not disappointed at all.
I ordered Paneer Sizzler and it tasted great. Actually beyond my expectation. It had fries, paneer chilly dry, hakka rice, exotic veggies, paneer gravy.
Masala chaas was also good.
Service was quick. Ambience was good.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: It was a pleasure serving you do visit again!! We are based in bhayander west.. near maxus mall.

Should improve the food quality and owner should be monitoring the quality he promised when we tasted the food for bulk order.
